title: Modelling the Correlation Structure of Uncertain Input Parameters for Energy System Optimization
summary: Statistical dependence among uncertain input parameters in stochastic energy system optimization models is often ignored, even though this can substantially bias outcomes. To address this gap, we are developing a comprehensive framework for characterizing, modelling, and benchmarking statistical dependence. In this work, we present a copula-based workflow to identify, characterize, and model linear and monotonic correlation structures between input parameters, representing the first development step towards this framework.
